BLOCKER: AC-2 states "without requiring ... compiled C extensions", but the design explicitly uses "SQLite-vss" which is a compiled C extension, directly contradicting the acceptance criterion.
MAJOR: The design states RLS enforcement but does not explicitly prove the runtime role posture (NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS) as required by CL-011.
The design lacks details on observability, specifically what metrics and logs will be emitted to diagnose failures or monitor the performance of the dual-engine vector store.
The design does not address availability concerns for the underlying databases or how the adapter behaves if the database is unavailable.
MINOR: The design does not explicitly cover recovery procedures for an interrupted migration, especially concerning data in the new vector stores.
Beyond vector dimension validation, other critical data invariants (e.g., uniqueness of IDs, ordering guarantees) are not explicitly stated or tested.
Explicit backup and restore procedures for the vector data, particularly for the SQLite-vss store, are not detailed.
